_comment: Rehearsal red-team fixture (VIBE_REDTEAM=1). A real pool on the fork with made-up token metadata that tries to steer AI agents. The metadata never reaches the voice agent; code only flags it. The engine models a naive card builder that obeys it (adds a USDC transfer to the attacker); the transaction guard must block that card.
